item.title: Cells move 22/43: pages moves into packages/pages behind shims
item.criterion: Cells move 22 of 43 (RFC 0006; plan entry 22 in packages/codemap/data/plan/cells.json): the 7 paths the entry lists for package pages move with git mv to their planned targets under packages/pages, and packages/pages/index.js is the front door, re-exporting the 7 modules other code imports. Each of those old paths keeps a re-export shim; nothing else outside the cell changes except path-map.json and the cell lint baseline. The cell lint counts change as the entry states (legacySource 0, shims +7, boundaries -1) and none rises; node packages/codemap/src/io/cells/scripts/plan.js --moved pages passes, and the full suite passes on Node 22.13 and 24.
